prompts.title: Resume the Beast OS build
prompts.text: Read ~/.claude/plans/misty-wondering-wren.md and ~/homecontrol, check `systemctl --user status beast-os`, then carry on with the next unfinished phase. Beast OS runs on {{beast.lan}}:{{beast.port}}.

prompts.title: Health check on the Event
prompts.text: ssh {{event.ssh}} and report: disk space on /media/topsee_SERVER, docker ps (Home Assistant + Jellyfin), memory, and anything failed in systemctl. The Event is {{event.lan}} (Tailscale {{event.tailscale}}).

prompts.title: Home Assistant: what's unavailable
prompts.text: Using Home Assistant at {{ha.url}}, list every entity that is unavailable or unknown and suggest the fix for each.

prompts.title: Restart Jellyfin on the Event
prompts.text: ssh {{event.ssh}}, restart the jellyfin docker container, set restart policy unless-stopped, and confirm {{jellyfin.url}} answers.

prompts.title: Tablet tunnel check
prompts.text: The tablet reaches Beast OS through an autossh tunnel to {{beast.lan}}. Check sshd logs on Beast for the tablet key and confirm {{tablet.kiosk}} loads.

prompts.title: Back up Abyss ciphertext to the Event
prompts.text: rsync the encrypted .abyss folders from Beast to {{event.ssh}}:/media/topsee_SERVER/Abyss/backup/ (ciphertext only, never the mounted plaintext) and report sizes.

prompts.title: Hermes / Ollama status
prompts.text: Check `systemctl --user status ollama`, list models with ~/.local/opt/ollama/bin/ollama list, and benchmark the vision model with --verbose. Ollama listens on {{ollama.url}} only.
